slug: 2025-05-12 Ghana's new National Identification Authority board to focus on public trust, inclusive service delivery

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports the new NIA governing board acts under what it calls the National Identification Act 2009, handling oversight and approval of regulations; the document's own citation, no Act 707 or 750 number given.
facts.system: National Identification Act 2009 (as cited by the document)

note: Board tasked with digital ID for all by 2030 is a target, not a cover fact.
